roles.ORG_ADMIN_desc: Manages members, settings, the competency library and audit logs.
roles.RECRUITER_desc: Creates assessments, invites candidates and shares reports.
roles.HIRING_MANAGER_desc: Reviews candidates and reports for their roles.
roles.TEAM_MANAGER_desc: Runs Team mode for the people they manage, with their consent.

landing.title: See how people really think, decide and lead at work.
landing.subtitle: Aalim runs realistic work scenarios that adapt as people answer. Every score is backed by their own words. People make the decisions; Aalim gives them the evidence.

hire.title: Hire
hire.body: Paste a job description. Candidates work through one continuous story, and you get role fit, hidden strengths, risks and interview questions, all with evidence.

grow.title: Grow
grow.body: Find out where you stand, then practise judgment, communication and leadership in scenarios with honest, specific feedback. Your data stays yours.

team.title: Team
team.body: With each person's consent, see your team's strengths and gaps, who is ready to lead, and who would learn most from working together.

evidence.title: Evidence, not guesses
evidence.body: Each level comes with a range, a confidence and quotes from the person's own answers.

adaptive.title: Questions you cannot game
adaptive.body: People write, rank, decide and talk. No option is the obviously right one.

people.title: People decide
people.body: Aalim informs hiring decisions. It never rejects anyone automatically.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: Assess candidates, develop your team or train your own skills.
signUp.dataNote: We use your email to sign you in and to send messages about your account. We never train models on your data.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. It expires in one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: You will be signed out on other devices.
reset.done: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.

onboarding.subtitle: How will you use Aalim? You can do both later.

org.nameHint: Candidates see this name on their invitation.

individual.body: Understand your strengths and practise the skills you want to build. Private to you.
individual.next: Your personal space is ready. Practice scenarios and your development plan will appear here.

home.personalSubtitle: Your personal space. Only you can see it.
home.deniedTitle: You do not have access to that page
home.deniedBody: Ask an organisation admin if you need it.

assessments.emptyBody: Assessments are built from a job description and the competency framework. Start by reviewing the framework your assessments will use.
assessments.reviewTitle: {count, plural, one {# report is} other {# reports are}} ready to review
assessments.reviewBody: Open a role to see its candidates.

home.growEmptyTitle: Your profile starts with a baseline
home.growEmptyBody: A 30-minute baseline will map your strengths across nine skill areas. Until then, see what each level looks like.

members.title: Members
members.body: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} in this organisation.

design.title: Design system
design.body: Every component, in both themes and both languages.

framework.title: Competency framework
framework.description: Nine domains, each split into sub-skills with five behavioural levels. Scorers match answers to these anchors, never to a hidden ideal.
framework.generatedNote: For each role, Aalim drafts a role-specific sub-skill map, for example SQL and statistics for a data analyst. A recruiter reviews it before the assessment goes live. The sub-skills below are the general fallback.
framework.emptyTitle: The framework has not been loaded
framework.emptyBody: Run the database seed to load the built-in framework.

members.title: Members
members.description: People who work in {org} and what they can do.
members.addDescription: They need an Aalim account already. Email invitations are coming.
members.emptyBody: Add the people who will create assessments and review reports.

errors.lastAdmin: Every organisation needs at least one admin. Make someone else an admin first.
errors.noAccount: No Aalim account uses that email. Ask them to create one, then add them.
errors.alreadyMember: This person is already a member.
errors.invalidEmail: Enter an email address like name@company.com.

profile.title: Profile

orgSettings.retentionHint: Default 12. Data older than this is deleted.

gallery.title: Design system
gallery.intro: Every Aalim component, built on the design tokens. Switch theme, language and numerals in the header: every specimen should hold up in all of them.

sectionNotes.foundations: Colour, type, space, shape, icons and motion.
sectionNotes.controls: Buttons are verbs. Errors say what to do next.
sectionNotes.navigation: One soft shadow, for floating layers only.
sectionNotes.feedback: Every screen has designed empty, loading and error states.
sectionNotes.assessment: The candidate's world: materials look real, nothing counts down loudly.
sectionNotes.report: Levels use one hue, never red and green. Every score carries a range.

foundations.typeNote: Inter for Latin, IBM Plex Sans Arabic for Arabic. Body line height 1.5, headings 1.2.
foundations.shapeNote: Radius 8 for controls, 12 for cards. One shadow, for popovers.
foundations.motionNote: 150–250 ms, ease-out, only to explain a change. Off when reduced motion is set.
foundations.motionPanel: Panels fade and rise 4 px as they open. Nothing bounces.

controls.roleTitleHint: Candidates see this on their invitation.
controls.emailError: Enter a full email address, like lina@northwind.com.
controls.notesPlaceholder: Anything the hiring team should know

navigation.overviewBody: A three-sentence portrait and an overall role fit, with confidence.
navigation.evidenceBody: Quotes from the candidate's own answers, linked to each score.
navigation.interviewBody: Questions that probe the areas with the lowest confidence.
navigation.dialogBody: Your answers are saved. You can come back to this link at any time before it expires.
navigation.howScoredBody: Two independent scoring passes matched the answer to the written level anchors. Where they disagreed, a third pass decided.
navigation.tooltipBody: Confidence grows when the same skill shows up consistently in different situations.

feedback.successBody: Sara Mansour's report is ready to review.
feedback.warningBody: The session ended before leadership and communication were fully tested.
feedback.criticalTitle: The report could not be generated
feedback.criticalBody: Your data is safe. Try again in a moment.
feedback.emptyBody: Invite candidates by email, link or CSV. You will see their progress here.

assessment.progressNote: Shows chapters, never a question count, because the length adapts.
assessment.lowTimeNote: Still quiet: it says how much time is left and never turns red or flashes.
assessment.documentsNote: Emails, memos, spreadsheets and charts look like the real thing. One critical detail is hidden in the email footnote.
assessment.editorNote: Light formatting only. Length is never rewarded.
assessment.editorHint: Lina strongly disagrees with your choice and says she will escalate. Write your reply to her.
assessment.pasteLogged: Paste noted for context ({count} characters). It never lowers a score.
assessment.rankingNote: Drag, or use the keyboard or the arrow buttons.
assessment.roleplayNote: The stakeholder has hidden goals and a mood that reacts to how you communicate.
assessment.roleplayReply: Fine. But I need to know today what you are changing, not just that you are sorry.
assessment.transitionBody: You launched on time with manual reconciliation. On Wednesday, Yuki's support team catches two mismatched payments before the client does. Tomás asks you to explain the plan to the client's finance director.

report.metersNote: The bar shows the level; the line under it shows the range. Lower confidence gives a wider range.
report.profileNote: Radar for shape, bars for reading exact ranges, and comparison of up to four candidates.
report.heatmapNote: Members × domains. A dash means not assessed yet.

invalid.title: This link doesn't work
invalid.body: Check that you copied the whole link from your invitation email. If it still doesn't work, reply to the email you received.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.body: Contact {org} to ask for a new link.

revoked.title: This invitation is no longer active
revoked.body: {org} has withdrawn this invitation. Contact them if you think this is a mistake.

landing.title: An assessment for the {role} role
landing.titleNamed: {name}, you're invited to an assessment for the {role} role
landing.intro: You'll spend about {minutes} minutes in realistic work situations at a fictional company: reading messages, making decisions and writing replies. There are no trick questions and no right answers to memorise.

story.title: One continuous story
story.body: A week at a fictional company, in four short chapters. Earlier decisions shape what happens later.

noTricks.title: Everything you need is provided
noTricks.body: Read the materials carefully. Say what you would actually do and why.

pause.title: Pause between chapters
pause.body: Your answers save as you go, even if your connection drops.

people.title: People decide
people.body: The assessment gives the hiring team evidence. It never rejects anyone automatically.

data.title: How your data is used
data.who: {org} sees a report of your skills, with quotes from your own answers as evidence.
data.how: Answers are scored against written descriptions of each skill level. Length, grammar and accent are not scored.
data.ai: Some scenarios and scoring use AI. People at {org} review the results and make every decision.
data.keep: Your data is kept for a limited time set by {org} (usually 12 months), then deleted.
data.rights: You can ask {org} for a copy of your data or for it to be deleted.

landing.untimed: Untimed mode: no countdown on any task
landing.consent: I have read how my data is used and agree to take this assessment for {org}.
landing.minutesNote: About {minutes} minutes. You can pause between chapters.
landing.startError: We couldn't start the assessment. Check your connection and try again.

quiet.title: Find a quiet place
quiet.body: You'll read emails and data and write replies. A laptop works best; a phone works too.

time.title: About {minutes} minutes
time.body: Only one task, the inbox, has a visible timer. Everywhere else, take the time you need.

pause.title: Pause between chapters
pause.body: At the end of each chapter you can stop and come back later with the same link.

offline.title: Nothing gets lost
offline.body: Answers save on this device as you type and sync when you're online.

briefing.title: A week at {company}
briefing.howItWorks: Each scene shows the situation and any materials on one side and your task on the other. After some answers you'll get a short follow-up question, or one detail of the situation will change.

item.readyHint: You can change your answer until you submit it.
item.submitError: Your answer is saved on this device but didn't reach us. Try again.
item.offline: You're offline. Your answer is saved on this device and will be sent when you reconnect.
item.timeUp: Time is up for the inbox. Submit what you have; unfinished parts won't count against you.

tasks.justificationHint: What would you do first, and what would make you change your mind?
tasks.rankingReasonLabel: What made the top two the top two?
tasks.writtenHint: Write it as you would at work. Length doesn't earn points; clear thinking does.

inbox.progress: {triaged} of {total} messages triaged · {replies} marked to reply (reply to at least {needed})
inbox.listLabel: Inbox, in your order of priority
inbox.decide: What will you do with this message?
inbox.pick: Choose a message to read it.

roleplay.error: Your message didn't send. Check your connection and send it again.
roleplay.hint: Talk as you would in real life. End the conversation when you're done, then continue.

forced.pair: Which is more like you? ({n} of {total})

transition.carryForward: They carry into the next chapter.

paused.title: Paused
paused.body: Your answers are saved. About {minutes} minutes remain. Use the same link when you're ready.

complete.title: Thank you, you're done
complete.body: Your answers have been sent to {org} for the {role} role.
complete.next1: {org}'s hiring team reviews a report of your skills, with your own words as evidence.
complete.next2: No decision is made automatically. A person reviews everything.
complete.next3: If {org} chooses to share your report with you, you'll receive an email.
complete.feedbackHint: Optional and anonymous to the hiring team. It helps us improve.

assessments.title: Assessments
assessments.description: Each assessment is built from a job description. Open one to invite candidates and read their reports.
assessments.emptyBody: Paste a job description and Aalim drafts the skills to assess. You review everything before candidates see it.

newPage.title: New assessment
newPage.description: Paste the job description. Aalim drafts the role summary, the technical skills and how much each area matters. You review and edit it all before publishing.
newPage.jdHint: Include responsibilities and requirements. Aalim also flags requirements that may be discriminatory or irrelevant.
newPage.jdPlaceholder:
Senior Data Analyst

We're looking for…
newPage.modeOffline: Analysed with Aalim's built-in role templates
newPage.analysingBody: This usually takes a few seconds.

errors.jdLength: Paste the full job description (at least 80 characters).

setup.title: Review the assessment
setup.description: Check what Aalim drafted. Candidates see none of this; it decides what the assessment measures.
setup.locked: Candidates have already started. You can rename the role and change accommodations, but not what is measured, so reports stay comparable.
setup.roleHint: The fictional company in the candidate's story is set in a matching industry.
setup.flagsTitle: {n, plural, one {# requirement to review} other {# requirements to review}}
setup.flagsHint: These requirements may be discriminatory or not job-relevant. Remove or reword them in your job advert. The assessment never measures them.
setup.acknowledge: I've reviewed these and will update the job advert where needed.
setup.technicalHint: Role-specific sub-skills, each with five level descriptions. Edit names, descriptions and levels, or add your own.

anchorTemplate.1: Does not yet apply this skill to the task.
anchorTemplate.2: Applies it partly, with gaps or errors.
anchorTemplate.3: Applies it correctly to a standard case.
anchorTemplate.4: Applies it well to a new or messy case and explains why.
anchorTemplate.5: Applies it expertly, anticipates problems others would miss.

setup.domainsHint: Must-haves get more questions and count double in role fit. Every area still gets a baseline.
setup.tooManyMustHaves: With more than five must-haves, a 50-minute assessment can't measure each one well. Consider making some nice-to-have.
setup.durationHint: Between 25 and 90 minutes. The assessment never runs over; with less time, confidence is lower.
setup.published: Published. You can now invite candidates.

errors.save: Couldn't save. Check the fields and try again.

role.emptyBody: Invite candidates by email, CSV or a link. You'll see their progress here.
role.emptyBodyDraft: Publish the assessment to invite candidates.
role.integrityTip: {n, plural, one {# integrity note} other {# integrity notes}}: context only, never a verdict
role.linkCopied: New link copied. The old link no longer works.
role.decisionNote: Reports inform your decision. Aalim never rejects anyone automatically.

invite.title: Invite candidates
invite.description: Each candidate gets a personal link that expires in 14 days.
invite.emailsHint: One per line. Add a name before the email if you like: Name, email.
invite.csvHint: A file with an email column, and optionally a name column.
invite.linkHint: Creates personal links you can share yourself.
invite.linksReady: Links created. Each one works for one candidate.
invite.sent: {count, plural, one {# invitation sent} other {# invitations sent}}
invite.skipped: {count, plural, one {# person was already invited} other {# people were already invited}}

errors.noEmails: Add at least one valid email address.
errors.tooMany: Invite at most 500 people at a time.
errors.invalid: Check the list and try again.

compare.title: Compare candidates
compare.description: Side by side on the same assessment. Levels show ranges; small differences inside a range aren't meaningful.
compare.emptyBody: Select 2–4 candidates with a ready report on the role page.
compare.note: Use comparison alongside interviews. People decide.

preview.banner: Preview: this is what candidates see first. Nothing is saved.

report.earlyBody: Aalim's scores are not yet calibrated against on-the-job performance. Treat them as structured evidence for your conversation, not as a verdict.
report.fitNote: A consideration for your decision, never a decision.
report.profileNote: Levels with ranges. Wider ranges mean less evidence. Open a domain to see sub-skills and the quotes behind each score.
report.noEvidence: No direct evidence; inferred from related answers.
report.potentialNote: Strengths beyond what this role asks for.
report.developmentNote: Phrased as what to build next, each with evidence.
report.conditional: Some patterns appeared only under certain conditions, such as time pressure. They may not show in calmer settings.
report.styleNote: Tendencies, not scores. Neither end is better.
report.interviewNote: Questions that probe where the assessment is least certain.
report.integrityNote: Context for the reviewer. These never change a score.

none.strengths: No clear strengths stood out with enough evidence.
none.potential: Nothing beyond the role stood out.
none.development: No clear development areas with enough evidence.
none.style: Work style wasn't measured in this session.

method.p1: The candidate worked through one continuous story at a fictional company. The assessment adapted as they answered: it formed hypotheses about their strengths and gaps, tested each in different-looking situations, and raised the difficulty to find their ceiling.
method.p2: Each answer was scored against written descriptions of five levels for each sub-skill. Every score quotes the candidate's own words. Length, grammar, accent and fluency are not scored.
method.ai: Scenarios and scoring used Claude. Important answers were scored twice independently; where the passes disagreed by more than a level, a third pass decided ({n} answers were double-scored).
method.offline: This session used Aalim's curated, human-reviewed scenarios and its built-in scorer. Confidence is deliberately conservative.
method.p3: Levels are estimates with ranges. They become more certain as the same skill shows up consistently across different situations.

report.pendingBody: Scoring and the report usually take less than a minute after the candidate finishes. This page updates by itself.
report.linkInvalidBody: Shared reports are available for a limited time. Ask the person who shared it for a new link.

actions.pdfError: The PDF couldn't be created. Try again.
actions.shareBody: Anyone with the link can read this report until it expires. You can revoke it at any time.
actions.candidateBody: The candidate receives an email with a link to their own report. It doesn't include interview questions or integrity notes.
actions.candidateNote: Candidates value seeing their results. Share only what your process allows.
actions.shareError: Couldn't create the link. Try again.
